events.summary: During the Siege of the Bone Spire, an angel appears over the charnel fields at sunrise, bringing new hope.
events.quote: As the sun rose behind the Bone Spire, an angel appeared over the charnel fields, bringing a surge of new hope.

events.summary: Knights charge on wings of wind and the necromancer's horde roars in helpless rage.
events.quote: The knights charged forward on wings of wind, and the necromancer's horde roared in helpless rage.

events.summary: With a single word the necromancer's legion is unmade.
events.quote: With a single word, they were unmade.

events.summary: With each knight from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers lose courage.
events.quote: With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers felt their courage failing.

events.summary: A squire takes up her knight's blade and holds the foe back.
events.quote: As the knight struggled to stand, his squire took up his blade.

events.summary: Grimnant knights bully an Urborg corpse shop owner and die.
events.quote: The first mistake the Grimnant knights made was bullying the owner of an Urborg corpse shop.

events.summary: Sathros turns his restraints to revenge.
events.quote: Sathros turned his restraints to revenge.

relations.note: Nylea's sacred lynx guards those who honor the wood.
relations.quote: Nylea's sacred lynx guards those who honor the Nessian Wood and hunts those who don't.

relations.note: A guardian watches over the city as Serra watches over all.
relations.quote: She watches over the city just as Serra watches over all.
